Gallery TAKE A LOOK AT OUR CRAFT From fencing to custom iron gates, stair railings, and garden features, we deliver custom metalwork combining beauty, function, and durability. All Gates Fencing Custom Ironwork ALL GATES Fencing custom Ironwork Transform your property with personalized ironwork built to last. Let’s bring your vision to life today! GET STARTED FAQ NEED ANSWERS FOR WROUGHT IRON FENCING AND MORE? WE’VE GOT YOU COVERED Which services are offered by Lambert’s Ironworks? We create, craft, and install custom gates, iron fences, and architectural ironwork—including railings, balconies, and structural accents—entirely in-house. Which locations do you cover? Our services extend across Dallas Fort Worth, serving homeowners and builders in Highland Park, Southlake, Westlake, Bartonville, Prosper, and other distinguished North Texas communities. What steps are involved in your process? We guide every project from consultation and design to fabrication, installation, and final inspection, ensuring quality at every step. This is true for all of our services, whether it’s installing a modern, custom, or wrought iron fence. Do your gates and fences operate manually or automatically? Our gates can be customized for either manual or automatic operation, based on your needs and preferences. What maintenance is required for custom iron? Iron stays in good condition with simple, periodic care. Clean it with mild soap and water, inspect hinges and moving parts, and touch up any areas where the finish has worn. Avoid constant sprinkler exposure—water is the enemy of steel and can weaken the finish over time. When needed, applying a fresh protective coating keeps your ironwork strong and looking new. How does an iron works company handle site conditions such as slopes, uneven terrain, or obstacles? We start with a full site evaluation so we understand the terrain before any metal fabrication begins. When a property has slopes, uneven ground, or built-in obstacles, we adjust the design, reinforce where needed, and install each piece functions smoothly, and reaches the highest level of stability. Do I need building permits for metal fabrication projects, and if so, who handles them? Some Texas cities and counties require permits for gates, fencing, or structural ironwork. We check the requirements for your address, let you know exactly what applies, and handle the permitting process whenever it’s required. Can you create designs that match my home or business style? Yes. Every project we take on is custom-built to match the architecture and style of your property. Our team walks you through design options, finishes, and functional details so the final piece blends with your space and does an amazing job of elevating both form and function. reviews.text: Mike Hoffelt and crew did an awesome job with helping us design our gate to the entrance of our new home in Robson Ranch. His and the crew’s experience built the gate then installed it perfectly. It added a wonderful addition to our new home. Lamberts Iron Works is worth checking out. Thanks again.
reviews.author: Ken Rudder

reviews.text: Lambert's has a great reputation and it's easy to see why. Thanks to Colin who did the estimate, Larry who took final measurements for the job, good scheduling and two fantastic crews who installed our puppy fencing. The job was done in a quality manner, careful about being in our neighbors yards and minimal disruption.  Really can't say enough good things about them.
reviews.author: Deborah Mentgen

reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about our experience with Lamberts Ironworks and their rep Angie Bates. Angie was very knowledgeable about the products, services and install. She went above and beyond to ensure that we were comfortable with the project and estimate. Pricing was among the best but the quality and installation was absolutely phenomenal. Angie provided great communication throughout the project and ensured that the final product was to our satisfaction. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Tim Ward

reviews.text:
Dated November 2025 -

Thankyou to Lamberts Iron Works - The Best Company for your Iron Gate and Fence needs !

1-Angie Bates in sales is Fantastic and super Helpful and Kind  - i had just walked into the shop with a driveway gate service issue and she helped me immediately and she wrote down all details of what was needed for my gate repair even though she is only in sales - and she arranged for the repair quote invoicing and she arranged for the service department to quickly complete the repairs! She also came out personally to do a fence measurement so that she can give me a quote for full fence painting. Angie's personality is so helpful and knowledgeable and "sunny" and efficient and she very quickly and kindly responded to my multiple questions and clarifications - she is fantastic and exceptional !

2-The repair team leader Ricardo with his full four person team came out to complete the Major Gate repair - they did an Excellent High Quality Job  - they are very Hard working and worked together with exceptional co-ordination and skill - it was a pleasure watching them work and Ricardo kindly accomodated even the small requests i had with the repair plan - they did everything that was paid for on the invoice and welded new hinges on my metal gate  ; replaced the motor arm and the electronics board box and repainted the gate - all quickly done with fantastic quality work !

3-Sage at the front office was also very helpful and kindly tolerated my multiple phone calls and quickly co-ordinated messages i needed conveyed to Angie and the Service team. Tim the owner also quickly and kindly responded to my email to him.

Lamberts Company installed the original iron metal swing gate at our house in 2002 and all the iron fencing and the gate ran flawlessly for 23 years before i needed repairs ! That it self is amazing to show the quality of work ! All the repairs done now in 2025 was fantastic - i am fully expecting it will last another two decades ! In todays world it is very hard to find companies that provide such Quality of workmanship and that are run so well and have such Fantastic employees that provide such Exceptional service - it is very obvious that all of them take Pride in their work at Lamberts and i am very grateful to Angie and Ricardo and Sage and to the Owner Tim and Lamberts Iron works for the Fantastic and Exceptional service ! I am a returning customer forever !

Thankyou again!
Sincerely
Abraham
Dated November 2025
reviews.author: D Site47

reviews.text: When we started working on making improvements to our back patio and perimeter fencing that we had neglected we were fortunate to get the opportunity to work with Mike Hoffelt at Lambert Ornamental Iron. He worked patiently and very professionally to design and install the best application for our home. The iron work was meticulous and priced right. We highly recommend Lambert that has a long history in iron work and recommend asking for Mike if you need their services. We plan to continue to use Mike for future projects we are thinking of.
reviews.author: David Foster

reviews.text:
Based on the recommendation of our pool maker, we hired Lambert's to create a custom railing and protective barrier around an elevated outdoor patio area.
I explained to Lambert's that were somewhat "under the gun" of the municipal inspectors to get this completed in a short amount of time.
Lambert's was on it! Colin came out, assessed our needs, and came up with a wonderful solution. In a very short amount of time, the railings and barrier were fabricated and installed by the date we requested.
Not only was the quality of materials and design element top notch, I was pleasantly surprised that Lambert's turn key pricing was very fair. Especially considering the time constraints we under. I believe that a competitor may have leveraged that maximize their bottom line.
Because of our positive experience, we will be hiring Lambert's again next month to fabricate another custom railing once a new retaining wall has been completed. A special mention to Jan Michael Llanda too.
Thank you Lambert's for an unexpectedly high quality product and install. You knocked it out of the park!
reviews.author: Dean

reviews.text: Mike Hoffelt at Lamberts was great to work with. He was a great communicator leading up to and during my project. Was a great experience!
reviews.author: Luke Roll

reviews.text: Fast, friendly service at a reasonable price. Very easy to work with a great mix of professionalism and friendliness. Committed to get your issues fixed. Jon did an excellent job for us.
reviews.author: Cyndy Hills
